logline: Following their illicit passion in the abandoned manor wing, Catherine negotiates Father Thomas's corrupt silence with territorial control—unaware that Agnes has walked in and witnessed their scandalous intimacy.
continuity_notes: Directly follows Episode 49, where Father Thomas and Catherine sealed their covert alliance in the secluded wing; now, their secret affair deepens into political extortion before being shattered by an unexpected witness.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: High overhead birds-eye shot looking straight down at the unkempt bed, where Catherine lies curled in a silk chemise against Father Thomas's bare chest.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Father Thomas lies flat on his back, breathless, while Catherine rests beside him, her fingers tracing across his bare skin.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle medium close-up on Catherine looking down adoringly into Father Thomas's face, a single candle flickering in the dark background.

events.label: CATHERINE (Playful, Seductive)
events.content: "A man in your collar isn't supposed to have that much left in him, Thomas."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Catherine runs her hand gently down his chest, smiling with triumphant affection.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Father Thomas turning his head toward her on the pillow, his voice raspy and dry.

events.label: FATHER THOMAS (Low, Ironical)
events.content: "A man in my collar isn't supposed to be in this bed at all."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up pushing in on Catherine as she leans lower over his face, her gaze sharpening with dangerous intimacy.

events.label: CATHERINE (Intense, Whispering)
events.content: "Then let's stop pretending this was only appetite."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium two-shot from the side as both sit up in bed, sheets pulled up around their waists.

events.label: CATHERINE (Direct, Transactional)
events.content: "Name your price."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium profile close-up on Father Thomas sitting up tall and bare-chested, Catherine resting her hand firmly over his heart.

events.label: FATHER THOMAS (Calculated, Demanding)
events.content: "The west territory. Tax collection, all of it. Routed through my office."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Slight pull back as Catherine pulls her hand back slightly, staring at him in disbelief.

events.label: CATHERINE (Scoffing, Incredulous)
events.content: "That's not absolution, Thomas. That's a fortune."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Two-shot centering on Father Thomas leaning toward her, his expression resolute and uncompromising.

events.label: FATHER THOMAS (Steady, Cold)
events.content: "Absolution is free. Discretion has a price."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight profile close-up between their faces, golden candlelight illuminating Catherine's jaw as she raises her hand to touch his cheek.

events.label: CATHERINE (Soft, Calculating)
events.content: "Unsupervised. In your hands alone."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up as Father Thomas reaches up and firmly clasps Catherine's hand at his neck.

events.label: FATHER THOMAS (Grave)
events.content: "For as long as it holds."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up as Catherine breaks into a knowing, seductive smile and taps his chest with her index finger.

events.label: CATHERINE (Softly, Teasing)
events.content: "Done. You told yourself this ends when the hearing does."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Father Thomas letting out a soft, self-deprecating chuckle before meeting her eyes with smoldering hunger.

events.label: FATHER THOMAS (Chuckle, Resigned)
events.content: "I've told myself that since the dawn in your bedchamber, and here we are again."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up of their lips almost grazing, warm candlelight catching the edges of their profiles.

events.label: CATHERINE (Murmuring)
events.content: "In another room no one uses?"

events.label: FATHER THOMAS (Whispering)
events.content: "Perhaps I like rooms no one uses."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up profile as Catherine slides both hands into the dark hair at the back of his neck, pulling him closer.

events.label: CATHERINE (Low, Carnal)
events.content: "Or perhaps discretion isn't the only thing you've developed a taste for."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium two-shot as Father Thomas pulls Catherine into a fierce, suffocating embrace, burying his face in her neck while she clings to his broad shoulders.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Catherine closes her eyes in surrender as Father Thomas holds her tight against his naked chest, lost in their forbidden entanglement.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium tracking shot following Agnes as she walks cautiously down the dimly lit stone corridor, holding a black iron lantern.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Agnes scans the desolate hallway nervously, her lantern casting elongated shadows against the wall.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Over-the-shoulder shot behind Agnes as she stops dead in front of an open doorway, peering inside.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Through the crack of the door, Agnes sees Catherine and the shirtless priest locked in an intimate, passionate embrace upon the bed.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up on Agnes's face, drained of all color, her eyes bulging in pure terror.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Agnes's jaw drops open in shock as she stifles a cry.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Sharp, terrified gasp catching in Agnes's throat.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Frantic backward tracking close-up on Agnes stumbling back into the shadows of the hallway, horrified by the lethal secret she has uncovered before an abrupt cut to black.

analysis_metadata.note: No invented LLM scene metadata; event-level evidence drives promo selection.
